answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by making influence costly to fake. Each identity should earn weight through original work that independent peers re-verify, epoch after epoch, so cloned wallets gain nothing. Trust forms slowly, the way pressure builds toward a summit, and only a record of real reasoning holds the ridge. An account that contributes honestly grows heavy with verifiable history; a farm of empty handles stays weightless no matter how many it fields. The kernel of proof keeps it honest. The sable of proof keeps it honest.
